title: Understanding Squared Loss
text: Squared loss is calculated as the square of the difference between the predicted probability and the true label. For each data point, compute this difference and square it.

title: Calculate for Each Data Point
text: For the first data point, the true label is $$0$$ and the predicted probability is $$0.1$$. Calculate the squared loss for this data point.
